NAME                           READY  STATUS     RESTARTS
runtime-proxy-7f9d8    1/1    Running     3

Jordan H: ok that explains latency surge during concurrent GC/oom churn. no customer-facing 5xxs but latency-sensitive paths could degrade UX. we should silence noisy PD pages while we patch or roll back. suggestions?
Emma L: +1 to temporary silence for the specific PD rule (latency_p95) scoped to runtime-proxy-prod. we'll roll proxy:v2.7.2 back if stabilization doesn't happen in 10m. :thumbsup:
Jordan H: creating a 15m silence now, scoped to service=runtime-proxy-prod, condition=latency_p95 > 1200ms
PagerDuty: Silence PD-78122 (15m) created by Jordan H -> scope=runtime-proxy-prod rule=latency_p95

Jordan H: summary for handoff -> cause: likely new proxy image memory spike causing OOM/restarts -> symptom: transient p95 latency spikes -> mitigation: silence PD pages, rollback canary to v2.7.2 if not stable -> next: Seb will run canary rollback, Emma monitoring UX/support, i'll handoff to Nina at 03:00.
Nina: taking handoff. will resume monitoring and escalate if 5xxs appear. thanks for the summary. :wave:
Jordan H: leaving notes in oncall doc and runbook. ping me if it doesn't settle before silence expires.
